notes_html:
Notes:

  • 1. This applies to CLINICAL PANCREATITIS ONLY, not isolated elevations in amylase/lipase due to a concurrent illness.
  • 2. Gallstone pancreatitis with retained stones should NOT be certified by AME as the risk of recurrent pancreatitis with incapacitation remains. (Applicant may have had an endoscopic retrograde cholangio-pancreatography (ERCP) with ampulotomy and opened the CBD but etiology of pancreatitis (residual stone/microlith/sludge) likely not resolved without cholecystectomy).
